stats_note: YouTube rounds the subscriber count (for example 1,230,000 for 1,234,567): this is normal.
err_hidden: YouTube hides your subscriber count: make it public in YouTube Studio.
err_auth: The YouTube key is refused: check it in Settings, on the page of the site's YouTube connector.
err_rate: YouTube has reached its request limit for today: nothing to do, it will resume by itself.
err_network: YouTube is not answering right now: nothing to do, we try again automatically.
err_config_key: Add your YouTube key in Settings, on the page of the site's YouTube connector, to follow your statistics (it is free).
err_config_channel: YouTube cannot find this channel: check the channel id in Settings (it starts with UC).
err_config_connector: To follow your statistics, the site needs a YouTube key: install what is suggested above, then add your key to it.
suggest_reason: keeps the site's YouTube key and adds your channel's counts, exact durations and Shorts detection
key_waiting: Your YouTube key is kept safe: as soon as this is installed, it will be carried over on its own, nothing to type again.
